T-saw–free osteotomy using an ultrasonic bone scalpel for en bloc resection of spinal tumors: surgical technique and outcomes
abstractText: Abstract Background Total en bloc spondylectomy (TES) requires precise vertebral osteotomy to achieve adequate oncologic margins while preserving adjacent neurovascular structures. This technical note describes a Threadwire saw (T-saw) free osteotomy technique using an ultrasonic bone scalpel (UBS) during single-stage posterior TES and reports the perioperative and oncologic outcomes of a consecutive clinical series. Methods Sixty-nine consecutive patients underwent single-stage posterior TES using a UBS between December 2017 and January 2024. The surgical technique is described in detail. Patient demographics, operative variables, pathological margins, perioperative complications, neurological outcomes, and survival were retrospectively reviewed. Results Fifty-four patients had primary spinal tumors and 15 had solitary spinal metastases. The median operative time was 330 min (IQR, 261–402), and the median estimated blood loss was 1,500 mL (IQR, 1,000–2,300). Wide, marginal, and intralesional margins were achieved in 62 (89.9%), 6 (8.7%), and 1 (1.4%) patients, respectively. No intraoperative dural tears, spinal cord injuries, major vascular injuries, or UBS-related neurovascular complications occurred. Seventeen patients (24.6%) experienced postoperative complications, most commonly surgical site infection (13.0%) and pleural effusion (10.1%). During a median follow-up of 46 months, the 5-year local recurrence-free survival rate was 86.4%. Conclusion UBS-assisted single-stage posterior TES is a feasible osteotomy technique that enables controlled bone cutting while achieving acceptable surgical margins and perioperative outcomes in this consecutive series. Further comparative studies are warranted to determine its effectiveness relative to conventional saw-based techniques.

Impact of Neonatal Intensive Care Technology on Neonatal Mortality
abstractText: Objective: To analyze the association between the level of complexity of neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) and neonatal mortality in Brazil, as well as the geographical distribution of NICU beds and variations in mortality rates over time. Materials and Methods: Data were extracted from two national databases: the National Registry of Healthcare Facilities (CNES) and the Hospital Information System of the Brazilian Unified Health System (SIH/SUS). CNES data were used to identify healthcare facilities with NICUs in Brazil, their classification by level (Type I, II, or III), and their distribution by state. These data were organized into a descriptive table. SIH data were used to analyze the following variables: NICU type, sex, age, length of hospital stay, hospitalization outcome (discharge or death), and admission date. All records of neonatal intensive care admissions in Brazil between January 1, 2008, and December 31, 2023, were included, while incomplete records were excluded. Descriptive analysis included absolute and relative frequencies for categorical variables and measures of central tendency and dispersion for numerical variables. Associations between categorical variables and neonatal death were assessed using the chi-square test, Mantel–Haenszel test, and G-test. Results: Type III NICUs had a lower neonatal mortality rate (10.6%) than Type II (11.2%) and Type I (12.0%) NICUs (p < 0.001). The study identified 10,244 neonatal intensive care beds in Brazil, including 1,632 (15.9%) Type I beds, 6,988 (68.2%) Type II beds, and 1,624 (15.9%) Type III beds. Geographical analysis revealed regional disparities, with Type III NICUs concentrated in the Southeast and South and a shortage of these beds in the North and Northeast. Graphical analysis suggested a downward trend in neonatal mortality rates between 2008 and 2021, particularly in Type II and III NICUs. Conclusion: Neonatal intensive care units with greater technological complexity (Type III) are associated with lower mortality rates. Regional inequalities in the distribution of these beds may contribute to disparities in neonatal outcomes, highlighting the importance of public policies aimed at promoting greater equity in access to neonatal intensive care in Brazil.

title: Walking Through Low Back Pain: A Comprehensive Review of Gait Research
abstractText: Abstract Background: Low back pain (LBP) is one of the most prevalent musculoskeletal conditions and a leading cause of disability worldwide, often associated with altered walking patterns that impair functional mobility. Despite widespread use of gait analysis in LBP research, the literature remains heterogeneous, making dominant research domains and trends difficult to identify. Objective: To map the research landscape on gait in individuals with LBP using bibliometric analysis, and to narratively synthesise thekey research domains, commonly reported gait variables and measurement approaches, and emerging trends over time. Methods: A bibliometric analysis with narrative synthesis was conducted. The literature search was performed in the Web of Science Core Collection on 22 December 2025 Using a title-field search strategy. The search was restricted to English-language original and review articles examining gait, walking, ambulation, or mobility in individuals with LBP. Publication trend analysis and bibliometric keyword co-occurrence analysis using VOSviewer were performed to examine research output, thematic structures, and emerging trends. Findings from the bibliometric map were then narratively synthesised with reference to key primary studies to contextualise the identified domains. Results: Gait-related research in LBP has increased substantially, particularly after 2010. Keyword co-occurrence analysis identified three main thematic clusters: (1) biomechanics, motor control, and gait variability; (2) clinical assessment, rehabilitation, and functional outcomes; and (3) population characteristics, risk factors, and performance. Across these domains, individuals with LBP demonstrate altered trunk and lower-limb coordination, neuromuscular control, spatiotemporal parameters, and movement variability. Advances in measurement technologies, including three-dimensional motion capture and wearable sensors, have expanded gait assessment approaches. Conclusion: Gait research in LBP has evolved into a multidimensional field integrating biomechanical, clinical, and population-level perspectives. However, methodological heterogeneity and a lack of consensus on outcome selection limit comparability across studies. Domain-informed and condition-specific gait assessment frameworks are needed to improve methodological consistency and support clinical translation.

Clozapine-Induced Myocarditis: Two Case Reports From Korea
abstractText: Clozapine is a highly effective antipsychotic, but its use is limited by potentially fatal adverse reactions. People of Asian ancestry have a higher risk of clozapine-induced inflammatory complications, yet reports of clozapine-induced myocarditis (CIM) in this population remain scarce. We present two cases of CIM from a Seoul National University Hospital cohort. Both were young Korean males with schizophrenia spectrum disorders undergoing clozapine titration along with concomitant valproic acid and olanzapine. Eleven days after clozapine initiation, both patients developed spiking fevers with elevations in inflammatory markers and cardiac enzymes; subsequently, they developed more severe symptoms, such as dyspnea, chest pain, and altered mentality. Electrocardiography showed sinus tachycardia, and echocardiography revealed decreased systolic function. After clozapine discontinuation, symptoms and abnormalities in laboratory markers and electrocardiography resolved. These cases illustrate the clinical course of CIM in Asian young males and highlight the importance of monitoring inflammatory markers during clozapine titration.

title: Suicide Prevention in Patients With Schizophrenia Spectrum Disorders: Assessment and Integrated Interventions
abstractText: Individuals with schizophrenia spectrum disorders have a higher risk of suicide than the general population. Suicide prevention is central to care for people with schizophrenia spectrum disorders. This narrative review integrates evidence on high-risk periods, therapeutic assessment, pharmacotherapy, psychosocial interventions, and continuity of care, with attention to implementation in Korea. Assessment should connect historical vulnerability, current modifiable factors, foreseeable changes, and available protective resources in an individualized formulation rather than rely on risk categories to predict suicide. Early illness and the period immediately after discharge warrant particular attention. Integrated care combines optimized pharmacotherapy, suicide-focused psychosocial interventions, early intervention services, and sustained case management. Evidence for improvements in suicidal ideation should be distinguished from evidence for reductions in attempts or deaths, and findings from other populations require cautious application. Hospital and community services should jointly plan transitions, confirm timely follow-up, and clarify responsibilities. Strengthening these arrangements, staff support, and implementation research may help translate assessment into sustained, coordinated care.

title: A Knowledge Graph and Contrastive Learning-based Framework for Cross-Domain Book–Movie Recommendations with Explainability
abstractText: An emerging approach called cross-domain recommendation transfers knowledge across heterogeneous areas, including books and movies, to improve the user experience. Existing methods often suffer from sparse interactions, semantic gaps across domains, and insufficient explainability. To address these limitations, we propose a novel Cross-Domain Knowledge Graph Contrastive (X-DKGC) unified framework that unifies knowledge graph modeling, contrastive representation learning, and explainable reasoning. First, a unified heterogeneous knowledge graph is constructed by integrating users, books, movies, genres, authors, directors, similarity links, and cross-domain semantic relations. Next, X-DKGC introduces two new modules: Multi-Hop Semantic Sampler (MHSS) and Dual-Domain Contrastive Learning (DDCL) to refine initial KG embeddings using intra-domain and cross-domain contrastive signals. A structure-aware regularizer is also formulated to preserve graph topology during training. The resulting embeddings support both recommendation and transparent explanation generation via multi-hop reasoning, semantic overlaps, and collaborative neighbors. Extensive experiments were conducted on both the original Goodreads–MovieLens dataset and the publicly available Amazon Review Data benchmark (Books and Movies and TV). The proposed framework achieved higher observed performance than the representative state-of-the-art baselines across both datasets, with statistical significance varying across datasets, metrics, and baseline comparisons. The proposed framework was also evaluated against KG-NeuCMF under identical experimental settings and achieved higher observed performance across the reported evaluation metrics.

title: Análise de Padrões em Casos Jurídicos com Mineração de Processos e Machine Learning
abstractText: A morosidade na tramitação de processos judiciais representa um desafio crítico para a eficiência do sistema de justiça. Este artigo apresenta uma metodologia que integra Mineração de Processos e Machine Learning para analisar o tempo de processamento de casos na Justiça Comum brasileira. A abordagem inicia com a aplicação do algoritmo K-means, utilizando a representação bag of activities, para agrupar processos com fluxos de trabalho similares. Posteriormente, esses aglomerados são subdivididos com base na duração dos traços, classificando-os em categorias de execução rápida, média e lenta. A etapa final emprega o algoritmo PrefixSpan para identificar padrões sequenciais de atividades recorrentes dentro de cada perfil temporal. Os resultados demonstram comportamentos processuais característicos e sequências de atividades predominantes para cada faixa de duração, fornecendo subsídios essenciais para a otimização da gestão judiciária e o aprimoramento dos fluxos de trabalho nos tribunais.

title: A new species of the genus Imachra Pascoe, 1874 (Coleoptera, Curculionidae) from the Philippines
abstractText: A new species, Imachra philippinensis Legalov, sp. nov., from the Philippines (Luzon and Mindanao) is described and illustrated. The new species is similar to Imachra sabahna Morimoto et Miyakawa, 1996 and I. siamensis Morimoto et Miyakawa, 1996, but is clearly distinguished from them by its narrower body, white narrow scales forming spots on the elytra, and aggregation of white scales under the eyes, on the thorax, and at the base of the pronotum, as well as by its very long antennae. The new species is easily distinguished from I. meridionalis Legalov, 2025 from Mindanao by the body with spots of white scales, straight and longer rostrum, long antennae, and non-subparallel elytral sides. This is the second record of the genus Imachra Pascoe, 1874 from the Philippines and the first record from Luzon Island.

title: GLP-1-receptor agonist therapies and periodontal disease: a retrospective pilot cohort study
abstractText: Abstract Background Periodontal disease and type 2 diabetes share inflammatory pathways. GLP-1-RAs may modulate these pathways, but their effect on clinical periodontal outcomes has yet to be clearly investigated. Methods We conducted a retrospective cohort study of adults with type 2 diabetes receiving routine dental care. Cross-sectional ( n = 132) and longitudinal ( n = 70) analyses compared GLP-1-RA users with non-users. Multivariable linear, quasi-Poisson, and logistic regression adjusted for age, BMI, gender, smoking, periodontal surgery, and follow-up duration. Linear and quasi-Poisson models additionally adjusted for the corresponding baseline periodontal measure. Results GLP-1-RA usage was not associated with probing depth change (B = 0.002; 95% CI, –0.262 to 0.265; P = 0.988). Estimates for PD ≥ 5-mm site count (RR = 0.650; 0.365 to 1.136; P = 0.140) and odds of exploratory relative response (OR = 2.609; 0.861 to 8.286; P = 0.094) were directionally favorable but did not reach statistical significance. Conclusions GLP-1-RA usage was associated with directionally fewer pockets with PD ≥ 5 mm and higher odds of meeting the exploratory ≥ 50% relative-reduction criterion, though statistical significance was not achieved. The preliminary findings of this pilot study do not confirm a periodontal benefit but warrant evaluation in adequately powered prospective studies in order to better inform clinical guidelines.

title: Student Motivation, Engagement, and Academic Performance within the Context of Math and Science Project-based Learning
abstractText: The collection of papers in this special issue examines the dynamics of math and science education from one large urban school district in United States. Papers range from early to late elementary classrooms with diverse student populations in K-7 schools. This editor’s essay provides a brief overview of each of the 7 articles and the authors’ contribution to the expanding STEM research on math and science education and academic performance within the context of project-based learning. Included is a mix of action research studies conducted at 7 different elementary schools by teacher-researcher-practitioners. The papers present diverse vantage points on the circumstances that influence student motivation, student learning, and student engagement within the context of project-based learning.

title: Implementation of a smartphone-based perinatal bereavement care training program for obstetric nurses and midwives: quasi-experimental study
abstractText: Abstract Background Obstetric nurses and midwives play a key role in perinatal bereavement care but often face limited training and emotional support. This study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of a smartphone-based perinatal bereavement care training program in improving perinatal bereavement care competence (PBCC) and alleviating secondary traumatic stress (STS) and emotional exhaustion (EE) symptoms among obstetric nurses and midwives. Methods This is a quasi-experimental study. 233 obstetric nurses and midwives from a tertiary hospital in Zhejiang, China, were enrolled (127 intervention; 106 control). The intervention group received a smartphone-based training program, while the control group participated in routine learning. Outcomes were assessed at baseline, immediately post-intervention (T2), and three months later (T3) using generalized estimating equations. Results Of the 233 participants, 206 (88.4%) and 198 (85.0%) women completed follow-up visits at T2 and T3, respectively. Significant intervention effects were observed for PBCC, self-awareness, STS, and EE at both T2 and T3 (all P < .05). Organizational support improved at T2 ( P < .001) but not at T3. Conclusions This smartphone-based training program is a promising approach for perinatal bereavement care education and training. Larger multicenter randomized controlled trials with extended follow-up are warranted to confirm and expand upon these results. Hospital policymakers, administrators, and nursing leaders should adopt this digital training to address staff training gaps and strengthen sustained support for better bereavement care quality. Trial registration This trial was registered early in the study period and before participant enrollment in the Chinese Clinical Trial Registry (ChiCTR2100049730) on August 8, 2021.

title: EFEKTIVITAS LABORATORIUM VIRTUAL PHET TERHADAP PEMAHAMAN KONSEP LISTRIK DINAMIS PESERTA DIDIK MTS ALKHAIRAAT BIROMARU
abstractText: Understanding dynamic electricity is important because students often experience difficulties in understanding the relationships among electric current, voltage, and resistance in series and parallel circuits. This study aimed to analyze changes in students’ conceptual understanding before and after learning with the Physics Education Technology (PhET) virtual laboratory supported by student worksheets (LKPD), test the statistical significance of these changes, and determine the magnitude of improvement. The study employed a quantitative approach using a one-group pretest-posttest design without a comparison group. The participants were 20 eighth-grade students at MTs Alkhairaat Biromaru. Data were collected through conceptual understanding tests administered before and after instruction and an observation checklist assessing implementation. The data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, a paired-samples t-test, and N-Gain. The results showed that the mean score increased from 43.75 to 53.75, with a statistically significant difference (t(19) = −5.210; p < 0.001). Cohen’s dz was 1.17, indicating a large effect size, whereas the N-Gain of 0.18 was categorized as low. All instructional stages were implemented as planned. Thus, students’ scores increased following the intervention; however, the effectiveness of PhET supported by LKPD cannot be conclusively established without a comparison group. Future research should include a comparison group and a longer instructional period. ABSTRAK Pemahaman konsep listrik dinamis penting dikembangkan karena peserta didik sering mengalami kesulitan memahami hubungan antara arus, tegangan, dan hambatan dalam rangkaian seri maupun paralel. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis perubahan pemahaman konsep peserta didik sebelum dan sesudah pembelajaran menggunakan laboratorium virtual Physics Education Technology (PhET) berbantuan Lembar Kerja Peserta Didik (LKPD), menguji signifikansi perubahannya, serta menentukan besarnya peningkatan. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan desain one-group pretest-posttest tanpa kelas pembanding. Subjek penelitian terdiri atas 20 peserta didik kelas VIII MTs Alkhairaat Biromaru. Data dikumpulkan melalui tes pemahaman konsep sebelum dan sesudah pembelajaran serta lembar observasi keterlaksanaan kegiatan. Data dianalisis menggunakan statistik deskriptif, uji-t berpasangan, dan N-Gain. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa rata-rata skor meningkat dari 43,75 menjadi 53,75, dengan perbedaan yang signifikan secara statistik (t19 = −5,210; p < 0,001). Ukuran efek Cohen’s dz sebesar 1,17 termasuk kategori besar, sedangkan N-Gain sebesar 0,18 termasuk kategori rendah. Seluruh tahapan pembelajaran terlaksana sesuai rencana. Dengan demikian, terdapat peningkatan skor setelah pembelajaran, tetapi efektivitas PhET berbantuan LKPD belum dapat dipastikan tanpa kelas pembanding. Penelitian selanjutnya disarankan melibatkan kelas pembanding dan durasi pembelajaran yang lebih panjang.

Implementation of Problem-Based Learning Assisted by Flashcards to Improve Students' Critical Thinking Skills on Landscape Material
abstractText: This study examines the implementation of Problem-Based Learning (PBL) assisted by flashcard media to improve third-grade elementary students’ critical thinking skills in Landscape (Bentang Alam) material. Methods: This study used a quantitative approach with a quasi-experimental, nonequivalent control-group design. The sample consisted of 44 third-grade students from SD Negeri in Semarang, divided into an experimental class (22 students) taught using PBL assisted by flashcards and a control class (22 students) taught using conventional learning. Data were collected using pretest and posttest instruments with 120 multiple-choice items (30 per skill) and analyzed using normality and homogeneity tests, paired-sample t-tests, independent-sample t-tests, Normalized Gain (N-Gain) analysis, and analysis of Covariance (ANCOVA) with the pretest as the covariate. Because of third-grade students' cognitive capacity, the test was administered in four separate sessions on four different days, with each session lasting approximately 45 minutes. Effect size was reported using Partial Eta Squared to measure the magnitude of the intervention’s impact. Both groups showed increased critical thinking ability after treatment, but the experimental group's increase was significantly higher than the control group's. After controlling for pretest scores, the ANCOVA results showed a significant difference between groups (F = 16989.679; p < .001; η²p = .998), indicating a large effect size. The experimental group's average N-Gain score was 0.7336, categorized as high and fairly effective, while the control group's average was 0.3784, categorized as medium and less effective. The greatest improvement occurred in the analysis and evaluation indicators. Implementing PBL assisted by flashcards effectively improves students’ critical thinking skills on Landscape material, as flashcards function not merely as visual media but as contextual problem triggers integrated into each stage of the PBL syntax. Keywords: problem-based learning, flashcard, critical thinking, landscape, elementary school.

title: Evaluation of bladder function in newly diagnosed thyrotoxicosis patients: a prospective controlled study
abstractText: Abstract Background Thyroid hormone excess increases β-adrenergic activity and causes autonomic imbalance, particularly in the cardiovascular system. Because bladder storage and voiding depend on a balance between sympathetic and parasympathetic activity, thyrotoxicosis may also affect lower urinary tract function. However, evidence is limited to a few small studies with inconsistent findings, and it remains unclear whether lower urinary tract symptoms and objective bladder function change after the restoration of euthyroidism. This is clinically relevant, as urinary symptoms in thyrotoxicosis may be overlooked. This study aimed to evaluate lower urinary tract symptoms and bladder function in newly diagnosed thyrotoxicosis before and after treatment, compared with healthy controls. Methods In this prospective controlled cohort study, 40 patients aged 18–50 years with newly diagnosed thyrotoxicosis were evaluated at baseline and after achieving euthyroidism, and compared with 37 healthy controls matched for age, sex and body mass index. Lower urinary tract symptoms were assessed with the International Prostate Symptom Score (IPSS), and bladder function with uroflowmetry and ultrasonographic post-void residual (PVR) volume. Parametric and non-parametric tests, Spearman correlation and multivariable linear regression were used. Results At baseline, 28 patients (70%) had moderate symptoms; after treatment, 38 (95%) had mild symptoms. Mean IPSS decreased from 7.03 ± 3.32 to 1.95 ± 1.71 (mean change − 5.08, 95% CI − 6.10 to − 4.05; p < 0.001) and was higher than in controls both before and after treatment ( p < 0.001). The improvement remained significant after multivariable adjustment ( p < 0.001) and was similar in patients not receiving antithyroid drugs. Symptoms were almost exclusively storage symptoms, mainly frequency and nocturia. Uroflowmetric parameters and PVR did not change after treatment or differ from controls. A borderline inverse correlation was found between pre-treatment free thyroxine and maximum flow rate ( ρ = − 0.31, 95% CI − 0.57 to − 0.00; p = 0.050). Conclusions Lower urinary tract symptoms are common in thyrotoxicosis and improve significantly after treatment, independently of measured confounders, whereas uroflowmetric parameters and PVR do not change within a short follow-up. IPSS may be useful for symptom assessment in thyrotoxicosis. Larger studies with longer follow-up and urodynamic assessment are needed. Trial registration Not applicable.

Dynamic modelling and forecasting of interest rates: evidence from Scandinavian countries
abstractText: Purpose Using unique data of three Scandinavian countries (Denmark, Norway and Sweden), the study examines the term structure of their interest rates and the performance of the Babbs and Nowman model in forecasting the rates covering their economic stability and financial crisis periods from 2000 to 2014. Design/methodology/approach The continuous-time multi-factor model developed by Babb’s and Nowman (1999) is employed for the research alongside the state-space form (TSIR) of the model. The linear Kalman filter algorithm is further implemented to produce the estimates for both the observable and unobservable variables. The dataset used in the study enables a critical assessment of the in-sample and out-of-sample performance across three versions of the multi-factor Babbs and Nowman model. Findings The research shows that the complexity of the three-factor model is necessary to better explain the yield curve dynamics in the case of Denmark and Norway, while for Sweden there is no clear benefit in adding a third factor. However, under the best predictive specification, the out-of-sample analysis produced different results for each country. The findings further exhibit that when considering the forecasting errors, the continuous-time models generate superior forecasts, a feature of great interest in pricing interest rate derivatives and hedging strategies. Research limitations/implications The study's empirical findings provide insights to investors, forecasters and central banks on the BN model attributes and its ability to explain the yield curve dynamics in times of economic stability and in financial crisis. Originality/value The research presents new insights on the BN multi-factor model applications on forecasting interest rates and draws on unique data of three Scandinavian countries (Denmark, Norway and Sweden). The study also provides a full spectrum of the model with application to the financial crisis period and for the post-crisis era.

title: Analisis Hubungan Pengangguran, Inflasi, dan Pertumbuhan Ekonomi di Deli Serdang
abstractText: Penelitian ini menganalisis hubungan antara pengangguran, inflasi dan pertumbuhan ekonomi di Kabupaten Deli Serdang dengan menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif berbasis data deret waktu untuk periode 2014–2023. Metode analisis yang digunakan meliputi VECM, uji kointegrasi Johansen, uji kausalitas Granger, IRF, dan VD. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan adanya hubungan jangka panjang yang stabil antara ketiga variabel tersebut, meskipun dalam jangka pendek hubungan tersebut cenderung berfluktuasi. Pengangguran berpengaruh negatif dan signifikan terhadap pertumbuhan ekonomi, sedangkan inflasi tidak berpengaruh signifikan terhadap pertumbuhan ekonomi. Oleh karena itu, diperlukan kebijakan yang berfokus pada penciptaan lapangan kerja untuk menekan pengangguran, disertai upaya menjaga stabilitas inflasi guna mendukung pertumbuhan ekonomi daerah.
